const _parsed = JSON.parse(RAW);
const LETTER_WAYPOINTS = {};
for (const [letter, data] of Object.entries(_parsed)) {
  LETTER_WAYPOINTS[letter] = {
    strokes: data.s.map(stroke =>
      stroke.map(([x, y, c]) => (c ? { x, y, corner: true } : { x, y }))
    ),
    hint: data.h || HINTS[letter] || '',
  };
}

export { LETTER_WAYPOINTS };

export const TRACING_LETTERS = Object.keys(LETTER_WAYPOINTS)
  .filter((l) => LETTER_WAYPOINTS[l]?.strokes?.length)
  .sort();
